g.text: Each column is one specification, sorted by its estimate (95% CI); the main specification is highlighted. Rows below mark its choices:

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #c3c2b7

g.text: cleaning rule (top four) and one change to the main specification. 12-month changes, HS6 × month and country × month FE unless marked.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Confidence intervals beyond the axis are clipped (value-weighted specifications). Data: data/published/robustness.csv.

g.text: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, international trade (imports for consumption, calculated duties); tariff orders compiled from the Federal Register and HTSUS (tariff_actions.csv).
